floors.name: The Waking Cellar
floors.epigraph: Where the keepers stored their little lights. One of them wakes.
arrival: Clear rooms, find relics, climb to the light.
floors.lore: The keepers of Emberkeep gathered every stray spark they could find and shut them in jars beneath the tower, to burn a little at a time. The jailer still walks the cellar with the only lantern allowed to shine there.

boss.name: THE HEARTH WARDEN
intro: It hunts by sound. Only in its lantern's light can it be hurt.

floors.name: The Drowned Cistern
floors.epigraph: The keep drank from here once. Now the water drinks the light.
arrival: Keep out of the deep pools. Climb to the light.
floors.lore: Beside the cellar lies the cistern that fed the tower. When the keepers flooded it to drown the sparks that escaped their jars, something long and patient moved in below the surface, and it has been opening the sluices ever since.

boss.name: THE SLUICE MOTHER
intro: She hides in the flood. When the water drains, she is stranded.

floors.name: The Mosslit Halls
floors.epigraph: The moss remembers every light that passed. It grew to keep them.
floors.lore: The tower's great halls were left to the moss when the keepers moved upward. It feeds on stray light, and its gardener tends it with roots that run under every floor.

boss.name: THE MOSSKEEPER
intro: Missed shots feed its moss; fire burns it through its roots.

floors.name: The Candle Crypt
floors.epigraph: Every candle here was someone's last light.
arrival: The mourners only show themselves in light.
floors.lore: The keepers who died in the tower were laid out with a candle each, and the candles never went out. The wax has been pouring for a hundred years, and the woman who dips new ones has started making them in other shapes.

boss.name: THE CHANDLER
intro: Her wax becomes fire. Stay on bare stone, or burn it first.

floors.name: The Frostbound Archive
floors.epigraph: The keepers wrote down every flame they ever put out.
arrival: The floors are ice. Fire undoes the frost.
floors.lore: Every spark the keepers extinguished was recorded here, on pages kept cold so the ink could not burn. The archivist still files them, and the pages have learned to fly.

boss.name: THE HOARFROST ARCHIVIST
intro: Her frost turns your shots aside. Burning melts it.

floors.name: The Ashen Kiln
floors.epigraph: Where the lanterns were fired, and the flawed ones thrown back in.
arrival: Watch the vents. Everything here wants to burn.
floors.lore: Halfway up the tower the keepers built the kiln that made their lanterns. It was never allowed to cool. The furnace at its heart has been fed so many sparks that it has started to want more.

boss.name: THE KILNMOTHER
intro: Strike her heart while the door stands open.

floors.name: The Clockwork Belfry
floors.epigraph: The bell rang the hours a light was allowed to burn.
arrival: Everything moves on the beat. Learn the swing.
floors.lore: The keepers rationed warmth by the clock. Their bell tolled curfew, and every lantern in the tower went dark on the last stroke. The clock still runs, and its keeper still counts.

boss.name: THE HOUR KEEPER
intro: The Hour Keeper starts the clock
Its hands sweep the floor. Dash through them on the strike.

floors.name: The Last Hearth
floors.epigraph: All the warmth the keepers took ended up here.
arrival: Daylight through the high windows. Every lantern lit.
floors.lore: At the top of the tower burns the hearth the keepers fed with everything they gathered. What tends it now is not a keeper but the light itself, grown vast and afraid of going out.

boss.name: THE LAST LIGHT
intro: The Last Light holds your glow
It fires your own weapon. Relight what it drains.

twists.name: Guttering
twists.line: Half the lanterns here have given up.

twists.name: Gilded
twists.line: Something here still pays in gold.

twists.name: Flooded
twists.line: The water rose while no one was watching.

twists.name: Windswept
twists.line: A draught runs through every room.
